sql_query:
WITH top_customers AS (
  SELECT
    c.customer_unique_id,
    COUNT(*) AS total_orders
  FROM orders o
  JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
  GROUP BY c.customer_unique_id
  ORDER BY total_orders DESC
  LIMIT 3
),
payments_by_customer AS (
  SELECT
    c.customer_unique_id,
    SUM(op.payment_value) AS total_revenue
  FROM orders o
  JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
  JOIN order_payments op ON o.order_id = op.order_id
  WHERE c.customer_unique_id IN (SELECT customer_unique_id FROM top_customers)
  GROUP BY c.customer_unique_id
),
items_by_customer AS (
  SELECT
    c.customer_unique_id,
    COUNT(*) AS total_items_purchased
  FROM orders o
  JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
  JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
  WHERE c.customer_unique_id IN (SELECT customer_unique_id FROM top_customers)
  GROUP BY c.customer_unique_id
),
reviews_by_customer AS (
  SELECT
    c.customer_unique_id,
    AVG(orv.review_score) AS avg_review_score
  FROM orders o
  JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
  JOIN order_reviews orv ON o.order_id = orv.order_id
  WHERE c.customer_unique_id IN (SELECT customer_unique_id FROM top_customers)
  GROUP BY c.customer_unique_id
),
dates_by_customer AS (
  SELECT
    c.customer_unique_id,
    CAST(MIN(o.order_approved_at) AS DATE) AS first_order_date,
    CAST(MAX(o.order_approved_at) AS DATE) AS last_order_date
  FROM orders o
  JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
  WHERE c.customer_unique_id IN (SELECT customer_unique_id FROM top_customers)
  GROUP BY c.customer_unique_id
)
SELECT
  tc.customer_unique_id,
  COALESCE(pb.total_revenue, 0) AS total_revenue,
  CASE
    WHEN tc.total_orders > 0 THEN COALESCE(pb.total_revenue, 0) / CAST(tc.total_orders AS DOUBLE)
    ELSE NULL
  END AS avg_order_value,
  rb.avg_review_score,
  COALESCE(ib.total_items_purchased, 0) AS total_items_purchased,
  db.first_order_date,
  db.last_order_date
FROM top_customers tc
LEFT JOIN payments_by_customer pb USING (customer_unique_id)
LEFT JOIN items_by_customer ib USING (customer_unique_id)
LEFT JOIN reviews_by_customer rb USING (customer_unique_id)
LEFT JOIN dates_by_customer db USING (customer_unique_id)
ORDER BY tc.total_orders DESC
LIMIT 100;
